cases.question: Tornado outbreak in Potter County. Triage critical lifeline infrastructure — which hospitals and power substations fall within the highest-risk tornado zones in the county?
cases.system_answer:

```sql
    c."hex_id",
    h."hifld_health_hospitals_n" AS hospitals,
    e."hifld_energy_substations_n" AS substations,
    t."nri_tornado"
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c
INNER JOIN 
    "HP_TOR_001" t ON c."hex_id" = t."hex_id"
INNER JOIN 
    "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h ON c."hex_id" = h."hex_id"
INNER JOIN 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e ON c."hex_id" = e."hex_id"
WHERE 
    c."County" = 'Potter County'
ORDER BY
```

cases.question: Flash flood watch for Webb County. Quantify population exposure and identify hexes with high social vulnerability and low community resilience.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
    pop.population_7km,
    vul.psvi_score,
    fire.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n AS fire_stations,
    hosp.hifld_health_hospitals_n AS hospitals,
    (SELECT SUM(pop2.population_7km) FROM "EX_POP_001" pop2 
     JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h2 ON pop2.hex_id = h2.hex_id 
     WHERE h2.County = 'Webb County') AS total_population
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
JOIN 
    "EX_POP_001" pop ON h.hex_id = pop.hex_id
JOIN 
    "VUL_004" vul ON h.hex_id = vul.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fire ON h.hex_id = fire.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hosp ON h.hex_id = hosp.hex_id
WHERE 
    h.County = 'Webb County'
    AND vul.psvi_score > (
        SELECT AVG(vul2.psvi_score) 
        FROM "VUL_004" vul2 
        JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h2 ON vul2.hex_id = h2.hex_id 
        WHERE h2.County = 'Webb County'
    )
    AND fire.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n < (
        SELECT AVG(fire2.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n) 
        FROM "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fire2 
        JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h2 ON fire2.hex_id = h2.hex_id 
        WHERE h2.County = 'Webb County'
    )
ORDER BY 
    vul.psvi_score DESC, 
    fire.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n ASC,
    hosp.hifld_health_hospitals_n ASC;
```

cases.question: Severe flooding in Webb County. How does social vulnerability compound emergency response challenges during an active flood? Identify the highest-priority zones for swift-water rescue deployment.

```sql

    h.hex_id,
    h.County,
    ROUND(v1.inv_median_income, 4) AS inv_median_income,
    ROUND(v2.sovi, 4) AS sovi,
    ROUND(v4.psvi_score, 4) AS psvi_score,
    p.population_7km

    population_7km DESC;
```

cases.question: Tornado striking Lubbock County. Assess the emergency resource gap — fire stations, law enforcement, and shelters relative to the at-risk population. Is mutual aid required?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(pop.population_7km) AS total_population,
    COALESCE(SUM(fire.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n), 0) AS total_fire_stations,
    COALESCE(SUM(law.hifld_local_law_enforcement_n), 0) AS total_law_enforcement,
    COALESCE(SUM(shelter.hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n), 0) AS total_shelters,
    ROUND(SUM(pop.population_7km) / NULLIF(SUM(fire.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n), 0), 4) AS population_per_fire_station,
    ROUND(SUM(pop.population_7km) / NULLIF(SUM(law.hifld_local_law_enforcement_n), 0), 4) AS population_per_law_enforcement,
    ROUND(SUM(pop.population_7km) / NULLIF(SUM(shelter.hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n), 0), 4) AS population_per_shelter
FROM 
    hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk AS county
JOIN EX_POP_001 AS pop ON county.hex_id = pop.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" AS fire ON county.hex_id = fire.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" AS law ON county.hex_id = law.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" AS shelter ON county.hex_id = shelter.hex_id
WHERE 
    county.County = 'Lubbock County';
```

cases.question: An active wildfire is sweeping the Texas Panhandle (Potter, Randall, Gray, Hemphill, Roberts, Wheeler), similar to the 2024 Smokehouse Creek fire. Assess wildfire risk and critical infrastructure exposure.
A tornado outbreak warning has been issued for North Texas (Dallas, Tarrant). Identify hospitals and healthcare facilities in significant tornado-risk zones.

cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
    h.hifld_health_hospitals_n,
    e_plants.hifld_energy_plants_n,
    e_sub.hifld_energy_substations_n,
    e_tx.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p,
    v.sovi,
    v3.nri_eal_CFLD,
    v3.nri_eal_RFLD,
    v3.nri_eal_HWAV,
    (v.sovi + COALESCE(v3.nri_eal_CFLD, 0) + COALESCE(v3.nri_eal_RFLD, 0) + COALESCE(v3.nri_eal_HWAV, 0) 
     + CASE WHEN e_plants.hifld_energy_plants_n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 / e_plants.hifld_energy_plants_n END 
     + CASE WHEN e_sub.hifld_energy_substations_n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 / e_sub.hifld_energy_substations_n END 
     + CASE WHEN e_tx.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 / e_tx.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p END) AS power_vulnerability_score
FROM 
    "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e_plants ON h.hex_id = e_plants.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e_sub ON h.hex_id = e_sub.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e_tx ON h.hex_id = e_tx.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v ON h.hex_id = v.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v3 ON h.hex_id = v3.hex_id
WHERE h.hifld_health_hospitals_n > 0
ORDER BY power_vulnerability_score DESC;
```

SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
    h.hifld_health_hospitals_n,
    e_plants.hifld_energy_plants_n,
    e_sub.hifld_energy_substations_n,
    e_tx.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p,
    v.sovi,
    v3.nri_eal_CFLD,
    v3.nri_eal_RFLD,
    v3.nri_eal_HWAV,
    (v.sovi + COALESCE(v3.nri_eal_CFLD, 0) + COALESCE(v3.nri_eal_RFLD, 0) + COALESCE(v3.nri_eal_HWAV, 0) 
     + CASE WHEN e_plants.hifld_energy_plants_n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 / e_plants.hifld_energy_plants_n END 
     + CASE WHEN e_sub.hifld_energy_substations_n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 / e_sub.hifld_energy_substations_n END 
     + CASE WHEN e_tx.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 / e_tx.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p END) AS power_vulnerability_score
FROM 
    "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e_plants ON h.hex_id = e_plants.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e_sub ON h.hex_id = e_sub.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e_tx ON h.hex_id = e_tx.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v ON h.hex_id = v.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v3 ON h.hex_id = v3.hex_id
WHERE h.hifld_health_hospitals_n > 0
ORDER BY power_vulnerability_score DESC;
